description: Defines a Java interface 'DeleteConfig' that specifies configuration settings related to delete operations, including methods to determine if delete events or namespaces are enabled, and an enumeration for default config values.

classes.name: DeleteConfig
classes.description: An interface for delete configuration settings, including methods to check if delete events and namespaces are enabled, and an inner enum for default config values.

classes.name: DeleteConfigValue
classes.description: An enum implementing KnownConfigValue describing specific configuration keys and their default values ('event' and 'namespace') for delete operations.

methods.name: isDeleteEvent
methods.description: Returns whether delete events are enabled.

methods.name: isDeleteNamespace
methods.description: Returns whether delete namespace is enabled.
